sentences.text: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.

Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
sentences.translation: 火灾生态学与管理专家Max Moritz教授表示,尽管野火发生频率的增加常被视为西部各州的问题,但由于其对联邦税收的影响,这是一个全国性的关切。

sentences.text: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
sentences.translation: 研究人员表示,这种观点需要美国社会对火灾的看法发生相应的转变。

sentences.text: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
sentences.translation: 首先,关于野火的讨论需要更具包容性。过去十年,焦点一直集中在气候变化上,即温室气体导致的地球变暖如何造成恶化火灾的条件。

sentences.text: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change – how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
"The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
sentences.translation: 他说:"人类系统和我们生活的地貌是相互关联的,这种相互作用是双向的。"他指出,未能认识到这一点,会导致"对解决方案可能是什么产生过于简化的看法。我们对问题的认知和对解决方案的认知变得非常有限。"

sentences.text: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be.
Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
sentences.translation: 与此同时,Colorado大学的Balch教授表示,人们继续将火灾视为需要完全控制、仅在必要时才释放的事件。但她说,承认火灾在人类生活中不可避免的存在,是制定使其尽可能安全的法律、政策和实践的关键态度。

sentences.text: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.

P1 My dream has always been to work somewhere in an area between fashion and publishing. Two
years before graduating from secondary school, I took a sewing and design course thinking that I would
move on to a fashion design course. However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in
this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right
path for me. Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because
writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities. But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought
that fashion and I together were just a dream – I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion

I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."

Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark
your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
Text 1
P1 Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their
local park. The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK
and more abroad. Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers. Runners range from four years old
to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley's world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an
hour.
每周六上午9点,超过5万名跑步者出发在当地公园跑5公里。Parkrun现象始于十几个朋友,如今已在英国催
生了400场活动,国外还有更多。活动免费,由数千名志愿者提供服务。跑步者从4岁儿童到祖父母辈不等;他
们的成绩从Andrew Baddeley创造的13分48秒世界纪录到1小时不等。
P2 Parkrun is succeeding where London's Olympic "legacy" is failing. Ten years ago on Monday, it
was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London. Planning documents pledged
that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches.
The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners. It has not happened. The number of
adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 – but the general
population was growing faster. Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate. The
opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
Obesity has risen among adults and children. Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012
failed to "inspire a generation." The success of Parkrun offers answers.

更快。更糟的是,现在这些数字正在加速下降。反对派声称每周至少参加两小时体育运动的小学生几乎减

P3 Parkun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock. The ethos welcomes
anybody. There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about

not make them worse.

励学校提供所有这些活动。但历届政府却主持出售绿地,挤压地方当局的资金,减少对教育中体育的关注。
未来的政府需要做更多工作来提供体育繁荣的条件,而不是空洞的、冠冕堂皇的战略。或者至少不要让情况
变得更糟。

doing something that isn't academic.

第4段，第1句
冒号引出同位语解释前文名词的结构在学术和新闻英语中非常常见，是四六级和考研阅读中的典型

replace tens of thousands of retiring boomers every year.
第4段，第2句
本句体现了真题中常见的结构特征:句首介词短语作让步状语、主句使用 need to do 结构、现在分
词作后置定语修饰名词。这种 "让步状语 + 主句核心陈述" 的布局以及不定式作宾语的搭配,在四六
级和考研阅读中频繁出现,掌握后可大量迁移到同类句型,典型性较高。

第4段，第3句
"主语 + 情态动词 + 系动词 + 表语" 是英语中常见的基本句式，情态动词 "may" 表推测的用法在

path for me. Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because
writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities. But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought

I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."

to compete with other creative personalities in the future,（to 不定式作结果/程度状语）★采分→
以便将来与其他有创意的人竞争
难点：creative personalities 译"有创意/有才华的人"
personalities 在这里不是"性格、个性"，而是熟词僻义，指"（某领域里有名气、有才华的）人
物、人才"；creative personalities 即"富有创意的人才"。这个 to compete 和前面 not good
enough 连成"不够好到能与……竞争"。
so I decided that it was not the right path for me.（so 引导的结果分句）★采分→所以我断定这
条路不适合我
难点：it 回指"读时尚设计这条路"；path 译"道路、方向"
it 指上文"在时尚设计领域发展"这件事；the right path for me 是"适合我的路"，path 此处
是"道路、发展方向"的比喻义，译"这条路并不适合我"最自然。
【调序】not good enough to 合成一句"不够好到能……"；so 顺译"于是"
把 not good enough in this area 和 to compete with other creative personalities in the
future 合起来调成"在这个领域还不够出色，不足以在将来与其他有创意的人竞争"，让 to 不定式
承接前面的"不够"；so 引导的结果分句顺译成"于是我认定……"。
【译文】然而，在上那门课期间，我意识到自己在这个领域还不够出色，将来不足以和其他富
有创意的人才竞争，于是我认定这条路并不适合我。

4. Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing
was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.
【意群】Before applying for university（时间状语）→在申请大学之前
难点：apply for 译"申请"
apply for university 是"申请大学"，before 后接动名词 applying。这块直白，译"申请大学之
前"即可。
I told everyone that I would study journalism,（主干主谓宾（含宾语从句））★采分→我告诉所
有人我会去学新闻
难点：journalism 译"新闻学/新闻专业"
journalism 是"新闻学、新闻业"，study journalism 即"学新闻（专业）"。that 引导 told 的宾
语从句，would 表过去打算。
because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.（because 原因状语从句）★采
分→因为写作过去是、现在仍然是我最喜欢的活动之一
难点：was, and still is 译"过去是、现在依然是"，别漏时态对比
writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities 故意用 was（过去）和 still is（现
在）并置，强调"从过去到现在一直都喜欢写作"。两个时态都要译出来，不能笼统合成一
个"是"，否则就漏了这层"始终如一"的意思。
【调序】时间状语保持在前；插入语 and still is 顺势补在"过去是"后
Before applying for university 时间状语保留在句首；插入语 and still is 紧贴 was，译成"过去
是、现在也依然是"，让两个时态前后并列，不用打散句子。
【译文】申请大学之前，我告诉所有人我会去学新闻，因为写作过去是、现在也依然是我最喜
欢的活动之一。

5. But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and I together were just a dream – I
knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all!
【意群】But, to be honest, I said it,（转折词+插入语+主干）★采分→但说实话，我那么说
难点：to be honest 译"说实话"；I said it 的 it 回指上句
to be honest 是固定插入语，"说实话、老实说"。I said it 的 it 指上一句 I would study
journalism"我会去学新闻"这件事，译"我那样说"即可，不必生硬译成"我说了它"。
because I thought that fashion and I together were just a dream（because 原因状语从句）★采分
→因为我觉得时尚和我（凑在一起）只是个梦
难点：fashion and I together were just a dream 译"我从事时尚只是个梦"
fashion and I together 字面"时尚和我在一起"，其实是说"我和时尚行业沾边、我去做时尚"这
件事；were just a dream 是"只不过是个（不切实际的）梦想"。译时要把字面"时尚和我"还原
成"我进入时尚行业"才通顺。
– I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all!（破折号后的补充分句）★
采分→——我知道根本没人能想象我会出现在时尚行业里！
难点：no one... at all 是含蓄强否定，译"根本没有任何人……"
no one could imagine... at all 用 no one 加句末 at all 构成强烈否定，意为"压根没有任何人能
想象"。at all 要译成"根本、压根"以体现语气，不能漏。imagine me in the fashion industry
是"想象我身处时尚行业"。
【调序】破折号转成"——"或"，其实"承接；强否定整理为"根本没人能想象……"
破折号后的 I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all 是对前句的进
一步解释，可保留破折号顺承，也可译成独立一句"我清楚，根本没人能想象……"。no one...at all
调整为汉语顺序"根本没有任何人能想象我进入时尚行业"。
【译文】但说实话，我之所以那么说，是因为我觉得我和时尚行业沾边只不过是个梦——我清
楚，根本没有任何人能想象我会身处时尚行业！
6. So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses that included writing.
【意群】So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses（so 结果分句+主干）★采分→于是我决
定去找一些与时尚相关的课程
难点：fashion-related 译"与时尚相关的"；look for 译"寻找"
fashion-related 是合成形容词，"与时尚相关的"。look for 是"寻找、找"。decided to look
for 即"决定去找"。这块顺译即可。
that included writing.（that 定语从句修饰 courses）★采分→（这些课程）包含写作
难点：that 引导定语从句修饰 courses，译"含有写作的"
that included writing 修饰前面的 courses，意为"包含/涉及写作内容的（课程）"。这是一个
较短的定语从句，宜前置译成"包含写作的时尚相关课程"。
【调序】短定语从句 that included writing 前置到 courses 前

定语在前，且从句短，故译成"一些含有写作内容、又与时尚相关的课程"，把两个定语都提到"课
程"前面。

7. This is when I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."
【意群】This is when（主干（This is when 句型））★采分→就是在这个时候

I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."（when 引导的表语从句）★采分→我注意到
了这门"时尚传媒与推广"课程

强调的时间放前、动作放后，顺畅自然。

Section IV Part A
Directions:
Suppose you are invited by Professor Williams to give a presentation about Chinese culture to a group
of international students. Write a reply to
1)accept the invitation, and
2)introduce the key points of your presentation.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)

Dear Professor Williams, I am truly honored to receive your invitation, and I am writing to gladly accept it. It
will be my pleasure to give a presentation on Chinese culture to your international students.
My talk will focus on three points. First, I will introduce Chinese calligraphy and explain how each stroke
carries a sense of beauty. Second, I will present the tea ceremony, showing how it reflects our value of
